technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Cloud Stream (s-c-s) architecture for migrating and porting modules (Cassandra and analytic-pmml) from Spring XD.
Implement Hadoop High Availability (HA) NameNode proxies to replace the non-HA proxies for custom module locations.
Expose new REST endpoints using Spring MVC to return job composition flags and graphs.
Update the existing Spring XD UI to handle the new REST endpoints and provide visual differentiation and navigation for composed jobs.
assumptions: The developer is familiar with the Spring XD and Spring Cloud Stream codebases.
Existing CI/CD pipelines and testing frameworks are in place and do not require setup.
Effort estimates include unit testing and basic integration testing for each activity.
The UI framework used by Spring XD is already established and only requires modifications to existing components.
No major architectural overhauls are needed, only feature additions and module migrations.

activities.activity_description: Implement the ability to connect to multiple external systems for the same binding type to read from one and write to another (U1).
Fix the issue in spring-xd-ambari where custom modules do not pick up NameNode HA, replacing non-HA proxies with HA-compatible ones (U2).
Move the Cassandra module from Spring XD to the Spring Cloud Stream repository, configuring it as a sink module (U3).
Port the analytic-pmml module from Spring XD to the Spring Cloud Stream repository, configuring it as a processor module (U4).

activities.activity_name: REST Endpoint for Job Composition Flag
activities.activity_description: Develop and expose a REST endpoint that returns a boolean flag indicating whether a job is part of a composition or standalone (U5).

activities.activity_name: REST Endpoint for Job Composition Graph
activities.activity_description: Develop and expose a REST endpoint that returns the full graph of parent-child job relationships (U6).
Update the UI to visually differentiate between job-composition workflows and single standalone jobs (U7).
Update the UI to allow users to click and navigate to the detail page of a job, regardless of whether it is singular or part of a composed job (U8).
Perform end-to-end integration testing of all new features and update relevant documentation.
